## Approval checklist

- [ ] Every nonempty human statement is entailed by its pinned KEEP evidence.
- [ ] Dates, repository refs, independent publication facts and late arrivals checked.
- [ ] Analyst classifications and migration guidance reviewed by a human.
- [ ] Every item is KEEP or CUT. No PENDING remains.
- [ ] Rerendered without --draft and verify passes for the exact committed files.
- [ ] Coverage gaps and stale sources are visible.
- [ ] I intend to approve public export by merging this private PR.
